sloka: शक्तौ तौ पुरुषव्याघ्रौ वाय्वग्निसमतेजसौ ।सुराणामपि दुर्धर्षौ किमर्थं मामुपेक्षतः ।। ५.६७.२३ ।।।।
transliteration: śaktau tau puruṣavyāghrau vāyvagnisamatejasau ।surāṇāmapi durdharṣau kimarthaṁ māmupekṣataḥ ।। 5.67.23 ।।।।

translations.english: "— in that those two scorchers of foes, though able and together, do not protect me." Having heard the piteous and well-spoken word of Vaidehi,
